rule: Metadata only. No image is stored in this repository. Do not claim any reference shows Kano unless its original location is established.

references.label: Dense traditional settlement around a rocky hill
references.ownerInterpretation: Visual reference for the Dala Hill environment, subject to geographical verification.
references.observed: Oblique aerial; dense low-rise fabric; flat or low-pitched roofs with corrugated sheet and roof tanks; tan and ochre walls; irregular lanes; a quarried outcrop with a reddish-brown face; few trees.
references.actualLocation: NOT ESTABLISHED. Consistent in character with the Dala Hill area as described in the brief; nothing in the image proves it.
references.verificationNeeded: the originating page or photographer; a map comparison of the outcrop and street pattern against Dala Hill (12.0093N 8.5070E, one source)
references.usableFor: environment mood, roofscape and density; the outcrop as a landmark silhouette
references.notUsableFor: building proportions (too distant); any claim that it shows Kano
references.classification: ChatGPT-provided visual research reference (screenshot forwarded by the project owner). Not an original photograph by the project owner, not a verified image of any named place, not a production asset.

references.label: Modern residential district
references.ownerInterpretation: Contemporary residential layouts, building heights, roofs, greenery and street arrangements.
references.observed: Two to four storey buildings with hipped or low-pitched roofs in red, brown, cream, white and green; walled plots; mature trees and palms; a wide street with parked cars; a line of hills on the horizon.
references.actualLocation: NOT ESTABLISHED. A distant line of hills is visible; the sources found describe Kano as a nearly flat plain, so the hills are a reason to check, not a conclusion.
references.verificationNeeded: the originating page or photographer; identify the hills and street pattern on a map
references.usableFor: contemporary residential massing, heights, roof shapes, greenery, street arrangement
references.notUsableFor: evidence of what Kano looks like until the location is established

references.usableFor: future road-infrastructure design inspiration (backlog items for roundabouts and flyovers); mosque type as one example

missingReferences.need: At least three distinct Kano compounds: the street front with the zaure and its door, the compound wall and its top (parapet, zankwaye), gates (leaves, piers), roof edge and roof furniture, windows, wall finish and wear. For each: a front, a side, a close detail, and something for scale (a person or a door). Heights and thicknesses of walls and parapets.
missingReferences.status: MISSING (no usable reference; R-001 is too distant)

missingReferences.need: Walled bungalows and villas with gates, shop rows and shop-and-flat blocks, a commercial plaza, an apartment block, a mid-rise block, a filling station, each shown as they are in Kano.
missingReferences.status: PARTIAL IDEAS ONLY (R-003 for contemporary residential massing once its location is established; nothing confirmed as Kano)

missingReferences.need: A real Kano neighbourhood mosque (not the Great Mosque): dome(s), minaret(s), prayer-hall walls, ablution block, boundary wall, colours and finishes; front, side and detail.
missingReferences.status: PARTIAL IDEA (R-004 shows one mosque type, location not established)

missingReferences.need: Shopfronts with shutters and sign bands, kiosks, market stalls (frames, tarpaulins, goods), bus stops, street-level views of a commercial street with its activity.

New, patched, cracked and damaged asphalt; edges and shoulders; open drains and their slabs; kerbs and sidewalks if present; road markings; how roads meet compound entrances. Close ground-level views with a scale object.
Poles as installed (material, height, crossarms, insulators, cables, transformer), streetlights (pole, arm, luminaire, median double-arm), road signs and gantries.
The species that actually line Kano roads and compounds (the typical street tree is NOT established by the sources found), their size and form, dry-season foliage, ground colour and cover.
Common cars, minibuses, motor tricycle taxis and motorcycles as parked along roads (generic shapes, no brands), and roadside activity (traders, loading, waiting).
Harmattan haze, dusty light, sky colour and shadow softness at several times of day.
missingReferences.status: PARTIAL (R-005 for haze, location not established)

acceptableProvenance: Photographs taken by the project owner or by a person who grants written permission for private reference (and for redistribution if they will be shown publicly).
Licensed or commissioned photographs, with the licence kept in the private asset repository's LICENSES.md.
Openly licensed images (for example Wikimedia Commons), only after reading each file's own licence page; the licence and attribution are recorded per file. Not every Commons file is freely reusable.

Archival collections (for example the MIT Dome photographs of Gidan Rumfa, the Smithsonian Eliot Elisofon archive): their terms are not established; treat as private study references until the holder's terms are read.
Generated concept images are allowed to supplement real photographs but must be labelled 'CONCEPT: not a photograph of an actual Kano location' in the register and wherever they are shown.
neverAcceptable: Copying or tracing a protected image into a texture, decal or model.
Presenting a generated or non-Kano image as a photograph of a Kano location.
